players.name: PhogsToffees

strengths.title: Passing accuracy
strengths.note: Keeps possession reliably - teammates can trust the ball with them.
strengths.coach: Kept the ball like it owed you money.

strengths.title: Getting shots off
strengths.coach: You kept finding ways to get shots off. Can't score 'em if you don't take 'em.

strengths.detail: Goals per shot on target: 67% (top quarter of forwards: 60%+)
strengths.title: Finishing
strengths.note: Clinical - beats the keeper once on target.
strengths.coach: Clinical. When you hit the target, the keeper was just a spectator.

strengths.detail: Key passes: 4 (top quarter of forwards: 2+); 2 assists, 4 key passes
strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Made chances for your teammates. Unselfish football is the best kind.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Found the back of the net. Never gets old, does it?

strengths.title: Match-winning impact
strengths.coach: Man of the Match. The game noticed, and so did I.

weaknesses.detail: Shots on target: 60% (bottom quarter of forwards is 60% or less)
weaknesses.title: Shot selection
tips: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.
Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.
Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.
weaknesses.coach: A few too many shots went wide or over. Better looks, better results.

players.headline: Outstanding forward performance (10.0, top 10% for the position) - best at passing accuracy, getting shots off; work on shot selection.

coach.name: Coach Lasso
coach.opener: PhogsToffees, that was a 10.0. Top-ten-percent stuff for a forward anywhere in this league. I'd frame it if I knew how.
coach.closer: That's the stuff. Same time next match?

push.title: W 4-3 vs FC Creamsters | You: 10.0 (top 10% FOR)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, I've seen sunsets in Kansas less beautiful than that 10.0. Top 10% for a forward.

DID WELL
+ 93% passing on 29 attempts, up from your usual 72%. Every pass had a return address on it.
+ 5 shots at FC Creamsters's goal. Fortune favors the folks who shoot.
+ 2 goals from 3 on target. Ice in the veins, honey in the heart.
+ 4 key passes (up from your usual 2). That's the kind of vision you can't teach. Well, I can try, but you already have it.
+ A brace against FC Creamsters, your 2nd straight match scoring. You put it where the keeper ain't. That's the whole trick.

WORK ON
- 3 of 5 shots on target. Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.

Before next match: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.

Proud of you. Now go drink some water. - Coach Lasso

players.name: BellyTb1

strengths.title: On-ball involvement
strengths.note: Heavily involved; the team plays through them.
strengths.coach: You were everywhere. Teammates looked for you because they trust you.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Found the back of the net. Never gets old, does it?

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Made chances for your teammates. Unselfish football is the best kind.

weaknesses.detail: Tackles attempted: 1 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 2 or less)
weaknesses.title: Defensive work rate
tips: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
weaknesses.coach: Need more bite without the ball. Defending is everybody's job.

weaknesses.detail: 22/34 passes (65%) - below the ~72% point where extra passes start costing rating
weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.
